label: Workshop manual
medium: a storybook opaque gouache illustration, thick body colour on a warm paper ground, visible flat brush-shaped marks inside each mass, subtle paper tooth over the whole plate, a dark-brown ink contour drawn last over the paint, never black and never close to neutral black; matte paint with body, not vector art and not a flat digital cartoon; bench, tool wall and trays painted as flat masses
composition: a centered bench and tool wall with no ceiling fixture; the only light is the single upper-left key; a wide quiet band above carries the headline, and the tool wall runs off the right edge
illustration_role: orientation only; never a torque value, clearance, part number or sequence
cannot_do: show a torque value, clearance or sequence as art

manifest_shape.loader_contract: roles[] holds only kit-local display plates: id/role/path/size/sha256/textless=true/source=curated_kit, every path relative and inside the kit directory, PNG. `resolution[role].source` names the 2x sibling a full-bleed plate is encoded from. Shared-kernel rows are references, not roles: they live in kernel.assets with their repo-relative path and sha256 and must be resolved through kernel.assets, never mounted as a kit-local plate.
manifest_shape.generation_log: the generation.json sidecar beside this manifest, pinned by sha256 here rather than inlined
divergences: a `section` role is VQ-008's own; field_atlas@2 has none, and the section ships no 2x sibling
covers are two aspects of one generic display cover, not per-course covers
generation_log is a pinned sidecar, not an inlined list
field_atlas@2 copies its kernel bytes into the kit and lists them as roles; these kits keep one shared kernel and declare it as references in kernel.assets, so roles stay kit-local plates

ocr_policy.tool: tesseract default page segmentation on the shipped plate
ocr_policy.fail_rule: a token of >= 3 alphanumeric characters at confidence >= 60
ocr_policy.calibration: real UI strings on refs/home.png and refs/classroom.png score 74-95; painted line art on these plates scores 12-52
ocr_policy.limitation: OCR is a cheap backstop, not the textless control. Recall measured this round on the shipped lab_bench hero with Liberation Sans Bold burned in: 120 pt 'TORQUE 45 Nm' and 'CAUTION' return no readable token at default page segmentation or at psm 6/11/12; 72 pt returns only isolated one-character fragments ('7' at 82.3, '4' at 59.4); 48 pt and 32 pt return nothing. A legible 120 pt line scoring zero shows recall does not rise with type size, and an independent 72 pt probe recovered one three-character fragment at 90.9, so a clean OCR run is not evidence that a plate is textless. The primary control is the recorded per-plate vision pass: every accepted row in generation.json must carry a vision and a residual verdict, and --check refuses an accepted row without either and a kit whose hero, 3:2 cover, section or lesson scene has no accepted row behind it. Painted pseudo-lettering is the same case with less contrast.

reference.note: the reference mockup(s) the accepted plates were generated against; mockups, not a source of course titles

contact_sheet.note: rebuilt by `python3 scripts/vq008-kits.py --contact docs/visual-review/vq-008`; every shipped plate, the shared kernel rows and this grammar's art direction

generation_log.note: the attempt log is a sidecar pinned here by hash; every rejected attempt is kept

kernel.note: shared objects, frames, badges, materials and fox poses are referenced from one kernel; a kit does not copy new bytes for them. These rows are references, not kit-local plates: resolve each through this block, never mount it as a role.

provenance.prompt:
Full-bleed painted plate of a PLACE, not a still life, cropped hard edge to edge by the frame: no torn or deckled paper edge, no white margin, no vignette, no border, no picture frame. Three depth planes: painted foreground props, a midground bench or table, and an architectural background with a window, door or opening, paler in the distance.

Subject: a small vehicle workshop service bay, seen straight on at standing eye level. BACKGROUND: warm ochre-stained timber plank wall on the right and warm cream plaster on the left; a wide roller door open onto a warm sunlit earth yard, and behind it, soft and pale, the flat side of a plain unbadged van and a wooden fence. MIDGROUND: a heavy ochre wooden workbench across the frame with a plain dark-iron bench vice, a row of open wooden component trays with blank compartments, and a tall ochre pegboard of iron hooks holding hammers, spanners and a hacksaw in flat rounded shapes; the pegboard runs off the right edge. FOREGROUND: warm ochre-stained timber floor boards running off the bottom edge, a low wooden stool with a terracotta cushion, a folded terracotta shop rag, a coil of terracotta hose, four plain ochre-painted tins with blank lids.

Composition: a centered bench and tool wall with no ceiling fixture; the only light is the single upper-left key; a wide quiet band above carries the headline, and the tool wall runs off the right edge.

Grammar motifs: service bay, car on a lift, tool wall, component trays, bench vice.

The upper third of the frame is a quiet field reserved for a headline typeset later: a plain painted surface with a couple of faint broad brush marks, low contrast, no small detail, reaching the top edge of the frame, still painted environment and not bare parchment.

Painted in opaque gouache on warm paper, dark warm-brown ink contour drawn last, thick body colour, visible flat brush-shaped marks in every mass, crisp brush-stopped edges, one soft key light from the upper left, one shade plane down-right in a darker tint of the same pigment. Never pure black, no gradient, no glow, no bloom, no vignette.

Warm pigments only, at most 5: warm paper, dark brown ink, ochre, coral, dark brown cuff. No blue, no grey, no neutral black, no steel, no chrome, no concrete.

Orientation art only. No torque value, no clearance, no part number, no sequence, no procedure, no measurement, no gauge, no dial, no scale, no ruler markings, no torque wrench, no numbered socket, no diagram, no cutaway, no exploded view, no arrow, no step number. Nothing in the plate is instructional and nothing in it is a specification.

Textless: no letters, words, numbers, labels, signage, notice board, wall chart, poster, chalkboard, framed picture, watermark, logo or UI chrome. No people, hands, faces, animals or fox.

provenance.pipeline: magick -modulate 105,75,100, applied to the provider raw before any crop or resize; then crop/resize; then magick -clamp +level 4%,100% applied last, after the resize (ART-BIBLE §9 rule 5)

quiet_field.note: the flattest band this plate actually offers in the upper 45%, chosen by the better of its measured contrast against contract ink and against cream paper

vision.checks: full-bleed bay, three depth planes, pegboard of plain iron tools, bench vice, component trays, no lettering on any tool or tin, upper band is plain warm wall
vision.residual: the van beyond the roller door is pale and unbadged but its tail lamp cluster is fine detail; the bench vice reads dark blue-grey iron rather than warm
